hornbaker1997.authors: Hornbaker, D.J., Albert, R., Albert, I., Barabási, A.-L., Schiffer, P.
hornbaker1997.title: What keeps sandcastles standing?
hornbaker1997.note: Oil films under 50 nm thick on polystyrene beads about 0.8 mm across raise the angle of repose sharply; in dry grains the angle is set by grain shape and friction.

pakpour2012.authors: Pakpour, M., Habibi, M., Møller, P., Bonn, D.
pakpour2012.title: How to construct the perfect sandcastle
pakpour2012.note: Open access. The tallest stable column grows as the base radius to the power 2/3; wet sand is strongest at about 1% liquid by volume.
